public_input.query: My partner and I are visiting London for the Spring Bank Holiday weekend (3 days). She absolutely insists on seeing the famous landmarks and iconic tourist spots - you know, the places everyone talks about. But I'm more of a hidden gems person and prefer discovering places that locals actually go to. We want to experience both sides of London but I'm worried we won't have enough time to fit everything in. Also, we want to try some outdoor activities since the weather should be nice during the spring bank holiday, and we don't want to spend more than one museum per day.
